relies_on: A targeted (positive) criterion is a BiddableCampaignCriterion; CampaignId and Criterion are required on add, Id and Status are read-only, and Active is its only status.
CriterionBid is optional on add for a location criterion: without it the bid multiplier is 0, no adjustment.
BiddableCampaignCriterion.title: BiddableCampaignCriterion Data Object - Campaign Management

relies_on: Multiplier is a percentage adjustment of the bid, -90 through 900 for most criterion types.
BidMultiplier.title: BidMultiplier Data Object - Campaign Management

relies_on: Targets adds, updates and deletes location criteria; reads name the specific type, Location.
A location may be targeted (BiddableCampaignCriterion) or excluded (NegativeCampaignCriterion).
CampaignCriterionType.title: CampaignCriterionType Value Set - Campaign Management

relies_on: A location criterion takes the Location Id column of the geographical locations file (GetGeoLocationsFileUrl); the Bing Display Name is for presentation only, and several IDs can share one.

This guide says a Pending Deprecation location still targets until it is deprecated within 30 days, while the LocationCriterion page says PendingDeprecation already stops targeting; both say a deprecated location criterion can still be read but no longer targets or excludes.
GeographicalLocationCodes.title: Geographical Location Codes

relies_on: LocationId, required on add, is a Location Id of the geographical locations file (GetGeoLocationsFileUrl); DisplayName, EnclosedLocationIds and LocationType are read-only.
A location the file marks PendingDeprecation no longer targets or excludes; a deprecated location cannot be added.
Read back, the criterion type is Location.
An ad group with any location, negative location or radius criterion of its own does not inherit the campaign’s.
LocationCriterion.title: LocationCriterion Data Object - Campaign Management

relies_on: The first criterion of a campaign adds a location intent of PeopleInOrSearchingForOrViewingPages (people in, searching for or viewing pages about the locations); PeopleIn targets people in them only.
A location intent criterion cannot be deleted and takes no bid.
LocationIntentCriterion.title: LocationIntentCriterion Data Object - Campaign Management

relies_on: An excluded criterion is a NegativeCampaignCriterion: excluding a location targets no location.
NegativeCampaignCriterion.title: NegativeCampaignCriterion Data Object - Campaign Management

relies_on: A campaign or ad group created through the API has no criteria, and effectively targets all locations (and all ages, days, hours, devices and genders) until criteria are added; Microsoft advises at least a campaign location criterion for the customer’s market.
Location, negative location and radius criteria are one set of geo criteria: an ad group with any of its own inherits none of the campaign’s, and one with none inherits all of them.
ShowAdsToYourTargetAudience.title: Show Ads to Your Target Audience
